provenance.written: 3 October 2026 during the authorised K1-K5 review repairs. Existing junction-path and transient fixtures are recorded retrospectively, not represented as predeclared. New traversal, path-contract and sweep-repair controls below were recorded before their repair checks ran.
provenance.authority: Michael approved fixing everything after the review and explicit discussion of documenting the junction-path numerical gates. This does not invent a separate Claude approval or retroactively approve earlier undeclared tests. No tolerance is enlarged.

rename_allowance.provenance: Existing F3 regression retrospectively recorded, with no changed value or acceptance tolerance

degenerate_overlay.expects: Recover missing GEOS polygon area with the bounded exact spherical intersector; preserve plate areas, exact accounts, no cross-transform transfers and successful restore. Invalid exact operands and insufficient budget still refuse.
degenerate_overlay.provenance: Supersedes the old correct-but-incomplete refusal policy after the authorised exact fallback. The full repair run identified its old refusal assertion; replacement checks retain the same fixture and tolerances.

ridge_on_a_trench.expects: Refuse because the computed D5 intersection X is not inside both the old ridge end segment and the advanced trench end segment, not because transient bookkeeping is absent.

declared_vertex_ahead.expects: Pass the unchanged degree-two samples, including exact landing, preserving their position; v2's refusal expectation is historical and superseded.
declared_vertex_ahead.provenance: Existing tests retrospectively recorded, not predeclared

bridge_admission.section_fixture_correction: The first trial used s03-b01, deliberately cut by the trench in the existing v3 bridge refusal control. Corrected to the existing whole-riding s02-b01 support and its centred chart. No acceptance criterion changed.
bridge_admission.rule: The supplied review's self-consistently forged map/3d return with non-finite velocity must refuse. Changes to event, mesh, supply or sink must invalidate forcing identity. A valid section return must survive close/reopen and a second moving interval.
bridge_admission.provenance: Adversarial duration from the review reproducer; other values are caller inputs, not acceptance thresholds. Recorded before these tests run.

junction_paths.rule: Three northern plates spread at three ridges meeting at the north pole above a fixed southern plate. The north junction has its explicit exponential path. Exact account closure, restoration, frame covariance and moving continuation use the existing criteria.

transient.endpoint_expectation: No birth or transient row on the zero-opening side; opposite side births and exact material closure. Restore every moving interval. Declared before the endpoint-repair checks.
transient.rule: Material born at the V-shaped ridge can reach the outer trench within the same interval; account separately for surviving and immediately consumed births. The finite-stock persistence fixture has a stationary follow-up; moving continuation is covered separately.

vertex_traversal.rule: A degree-two vertex ahead on an unchanged incident line is passed, including exact landing and multiple vertices. Each accepted interval restores and continues. This supersedes v2 declared_vertex_ahead's refusal expectation, without rewriting that historical file.

junction_path_contract.rule: Use the existing chart and angular-resolution bounds. A near-antipodal exact path needs two conditioned chords; a small circle requires four, so a dyadic ceiling of three refuses. Construction checks probe either side of the existing band and pi/2 with nextafter. No new numerical tolerance.

sweep_repair.benchmark_amendment: 48/96 evaluated first; 96 did not enter exact fallback, so the already scoped 192-band review control was added before measuring it. Retain and report the 96-band no-fallback result too.
sweep_repair.rule: Exercise C7 thin, transitional and out-of-range sweeps. The C7 report follows the existing piecewise size rule. Compare exact-fallback row bytes before/after conservative spatial rejection and deterministic per-donor triangulation reuse; matched 48/96/192-band timings, unchanged tolerances and budget.

d5_traversal.provenance: Added 3 October 2026 (evening) for review item N1, after the refusal messages were changed and the cases were first probed. Not predeclared. Refusals only: no case is newly admitted and no tolerance changes.

d5_traversal.rule: D1-b at a junction where a plate builds a D5 triangle is not constructed. A pass of the vertex that ends that triangle's trench segment, or of a vertex at or between X and the new junction, is refused by name, not with a misleading geometric cause; a vertex between the new junction and X that was not passed is named in the X-outside refusal (X lies beyond it). A pass outside the triangle on the zero-opening side stays admitted, with exact closure and restore.
